subject: MAP alignment: target close & procurement signature deadline - FintechCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft & next steps

Hi Asha —

Great to meet you and the FintechCo team today. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the pricing term sheet. High-level recap and proposed next steps below: 

MAP (attached: FintechCo_MAP_v1.docx) — proposed milestones:
- Mar 30: Redwood sends updated MAP + redline-friendly term sheet (owner: Marissa)
- Apr 5: FintechCo Legal & Procurement review (owner: Asha / Procurement)
- Apr 12: Security deliverables: SOC 2 self-attestation + answers to questionnaire (owner: Redwood Security)
- Apr 20: Purchase Order / commercial approval (owner: Procurement)
- May 1: Contract signature & target close / kickoff (owner: FintechCo + Redwood)

Dependencies / asks from FintechCo: 
- Confirm procurement's internal approval timeline and whether Apr 20 PO is achievable.
- Share any required contract language or non-negotiables up front so we can prepare a clean term sheet.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I will update the MAP with the dates above and circulate a version for signature-ready review by EOD tomorrow.
- Pricing term sheet attached (FintechCo_Pricing_Termsheet_v2.pdf) — please flag any licensing or billing constraints.

Please confirm the procurement signature deadline that your team needs to hit May 1, or if we should adjust the target close. If Apr 20 PO is tight, let us know and we can propose contingency options (shorter pilot, phased billing, etc.).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: FintechCo_MAP_v1.docx, FintechCo_Pricing_Termsheet_v2.pdf

From: Asha Patel <asha@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & next steps

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the fast follow. Quick notes from our side after internal sync: 

- Procurement note: to hit a May 1 signature we need the commercial terms + clean PO to Procurement by Apr 20 at the latest. Our Legal generally needs ~5 business days to review a final term sheet, so earlier is better.
- Realistic internal timeline: if we receive a redline-friendly term sheet by Apr 15, Procurement can prioritize to meet Apr 20 PO. If term sheet slips later than Apr 15 we risk missing the May 1 signature and pushing to mid-May.
- Security: our security team will need SOC 2 report + completed security questionnaire before we can accept production data. Can Redwood provide the SOC 2 packet and questionnaire responses by Apr 12?

I'm adding Procurement and Tom (CFO) here — Tom, would appreciate a quick confirmation that Apr 20 PO / May 1 signature are acceptable from your side given current budget cycle.

For now, Marissa, please treat Apr 15 (term sheet) and Apr 20 (PO) as the dates to hit if we want May 1 close. If you can update the MAP with those hard deadlines and call out owners for each milestone, we can lock this in on our side.

Thanks,
Asha
Director of Product Partnerships | FintechCo
asha@fintechco.com

Thanks Asha — this is super helpful. I updated the MAP attached (FintechCo_MAP_v1.docx) to reflect the dates you requested and clarified owners. Highlights of the updated MAP: 

Updated milestones / owners: 
- Apr 12 (by EOD): Security deliverables — SOC 2 packet + completed security questionnaire (owner: Redwood Security; attachment: FintechCo_Security_QA.pdf)
- Apr 15: Redwood to provide final, redline-friendly term sheet (owner: Marissa Cole)
- Apr 20: FintechCo to issue PO / commercial approval (owner: Procurement, FintechCo)
- May 1: Contract signature & kickoff (owner: FintechCo + Redwood)

Contingency plan (if legal review pushes):
- Option A: Short pilot contract with limited spend to begin integration while final T&Cs are negotiated (target pilot start: May 3)
- Option B: Delay signature to May 15 and schedule a prioritized implementation window to keep onboarding momentum

Action items I'll take right now:
- Upload updated MAP and term sheet to HubSpot (link below) and send an EOD deck to Procurement summarizing commercial terms.
- Coordinate with Security to get the SOC 2 packet to FintechCo by Apr 12.

Camila / Priyom: can you confirm internal owners for SOW and onboarding scheduling? Also, Priyom, appreciate if you can prepare a short CS onboarding plan that fits the May 1 kickoff assumption — we can convert if the date shifts.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8721
DocuSign placeholder (will send when term sheet is finalized): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/123456789

Thanks — updating the MAP now and will resend for a final quick review by EOD.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Marissa — updated MAP looks good. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Camila: I will own the SOW draft and scheduling the implementation kickoff. I’ll prepare an initial SOW outline by Apr 7 and a proposed kickoff calendar for the week of May 4 (contingent on May 1 signature).
- Priyom: can you own the CS onboarding plan and a short success criteria doc we can include in the MAP? Also, please prepare a rollback plan / phased rollout notes if we end up doing a pilot (Option A).
- Priyom: I’ll also coordinate with Security to include the SOC 2 packet in the packet we send to Asha.

Priyom — over to you for CS plan; Marissa, I’ll help with any commercial followups with Procurement if needed.

Best,
